beats.label: S1 · The setup
beats.text: Rebecca Welton, awarded AFC Richmond in her divorce, hires Wichita football coach Ted Lasso to sink the club as revenge on her cheating ex Rupert.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The entire show's premise. Reader must know Ted's presence is a sabotage plot, not a hiring.

beats.label: S1 · Sabotage vs charm
beats.text: Rebecca plants a tabloid photo of Ted with model Keeley Jones, but reporter Trent Crimm's positive piece on the 'Lasso Way' begins to undermine her plan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Rebecca's active sabotage AND that Ted's kindness is neutralising it — the core tension of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Rupert resurfaces
beats.text: Rupert crashes Rebecca's charity ball to humiliate her, later helping his new fiancée Bex buy minority shares in Richmond to cement his hold.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rupert is the true antagonist across all three seasons; his return here plants the West Ham storyline.

beats.label: S1 · Jamie gone, Roy and Keeley
beats.text: After Keeley leaves Jamie, Ted benches him and Manchester City recalls him mid-season; Keeley and Roy begin circling each other.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Jamie from Richmond and pairs the core relationship that anchors seasons 2 and 3.

beats.label: S1 · Ted breaks, Rebecca confesses
beats.text: Ted signs his divorce papers and has a panic attack Rebecca comforts him through; days later she confesses her sabotage plot and he forgives her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two central emotional facts: Ted's marriage is over and Rebecca has switched sides. Nothing after this makes sense without both.

beats.label: S1 · Roy fades, Nate rises
beats.text: Aging captain Roy accepts a reduced role and hands the armband to Isaac, while Ted promotes kit man Nate to assistant coach for his tactical mind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nate's promotion is the seed of season 2's villain arc; Roy's decline sets up his retirement and coaching path.

beats.label: S1 · Relegated, but committed
beats.text: Roy tears his knee tackling Jamie in the final match; Manchester City win and Richmond are relegated, but Ted and Rebecca vow to earn promotion and win the league.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The status Richmond enters season 2 in — relegated, chastened, and Ted-and-Rebecca allied against the odds.

cliffhanger.text: AFC Richmond have been relegated to the Championship despite Ted's culture change; Ted and Rebecca have committed to earning promotion next season and eventually winning the Premier League. Roy has just injured his knee in the final match and kissed Keeley for the first time.
questions: Can Ted's American methods actually produce results without Roy or Jamie on the pitch?
What does Rupert do next, now that his fiancée Bex owns minority shares and a baby is on the way?
Where does Roy go with his career over and Keeley just entering his life?

characters.name: Ted Lasso
characters.line: American coach who was hired to sabotage Richmond, ended up beloved by the club, and just signed his divorce papers.

characters.name: Rebecca Welton
characters.line: Richmond's owner who confessed her sabotage plot to Ted and is now his ally, committed to rebuilding the club.

characters.name: Rupert Mannion
characters.line: Rebecca's charming, ruthless ex-husband, engaged to Bex with a baby coming and still working to hurt Rebecca.

characters.name: Roy Kent
characters.line: Grizzled captain who injured his knee in the final match — and who just started dating Keeley.

characters.name: Keeley Jones
characters.line: Savvy model who left Jamie for Roy and became Rebecca's closest confidante at the club.

characters.name: Jamie Tartt
characters.line: Arrogant striker Ted benched, returned to Manchester City, and who just assisted the goal that relegated Richmond.

characters.name: Coach Beard
characters.line: Ted's laconic best friend and assistant, the only one who fully understands his American ways.

characters.name: Nate Shelley
characters.line: Timid kit man Ted spotted for his tactical mind, just promoted to assistant coach.

characters.name: Higgins
characters.line: Director of football who quit rather than abet Rebecca's sabotage, then returned once she came clean.

characters.name: Sam Obisanya
characters.line: Earnest young Nigerian player Ted has mentored from homesick rookie into a committed teammate.

beats.label: S2 · Sharon arrives
beats.text: Richmond hire sports psychologist Sharon Fieldstone after striker Dani Rojas develops the yips from accidentally killing the club mascot with a penalty kick.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sharon is the vehicle that cracks Ted open all season; the reader must know why she is in the building.

beats.label: S2 · Jamie comes home
beats.text: After being dropped by Manchester City and briefly humiliated on a reality show, Jamie asks Ted to take him back, and Richmond ultimately re-signs him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jamie's return is prerequisite to his reformation arc, the punch of his father, and his eventual bond with Roy.

beats.label: S2 · Rebecca and Sam, in secret
beats.text: Rebecca unwittingly matches with player Sam Obisanya on the anonymous dating app Bantr; after weeks of hesitation they secretly begin sleeping together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The affair carries Rebecca's whole season and its ending shapes Sam's decision about his future.

beats.label: S2 · Nate the Wonder Kid
beats.text: Nate calls a match-winning substitution that goes viral as 'Wonder Kid'; craving recognition his stern father won't give, he begins bullying colleagues.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nate's slide into cruelty is the season's real spine; every step of his eventual betrayal follows from this.

beats.label: S2 · Ted opens up
beats.text: Ted's panic attacks send him into therapy with Sharon, where he finally reveals his father died by suicide when Ted was sixteen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The private wound behind Ted's kindness. The information Nate later weaponises against him.

beats.label: S2 · Sam stays, Rebecca lets go
beats.text: Rebecca ends things with Sam at her father's funeral fearing heartbreak; weeks later Sam turns down a huge offer from Ghanaian billionaire Edwin Akufo to stay at Richmond.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the affair and keeps Sam in the show, which matters for his season 3 restaurant and Akufo storylines.

beats.label: S2 · The Believe sign torn down
beats.text: Nate leaks Ted's panic attack to the press then tears down the Believe sign as Richmond earn promotion; weeks later he resurfaces as head coach at Rupert's newly bought West Ham.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's whole engine converges here: Nate's betrayal, Richmond's return to the Premier League, and Rupert's new weapon.

cliffhanger.text: Newly promoted Richmond will re-enter the Premier League against Rupert's newly acquired West Ham United, whose head coach is Nate — the man Ted mentored, who just leaked Ted's panic attack to the press and defected. Rebecca has ended her secret affair with Sam, and Keeley is starting her own PR firm.
questions: What does Nate become in Rupert's hands, and can Ted forgive him?
Where do Rebecca and Sam land now that both wanted to keep going and she ended it?
Can Keeley run her own firm and stay with Roy while Jamie has just told her he loves her?

characters.name: Ted Lasso
characters.line: Manager in real therapy for the first time, having finally spoken aloud that his father died by suicide when he was sixteen.

characters.name: Nate Shelley
characters.line: Went from assistant coach to Ted's public betrayer to head coach of Rupert's West Ham within weeks.

characters.name: Rebecca Welton
characters.line: Owner who buried her father and ended her secret affair with Sam, fearing heartbreak.

characters.name: Sam Obisanya
characters.line: Rising star who turned down Akufo's mega-offer to stay at Richmond, and whom Rebecca left.

characters.name: Jamie Tartt
characters.line: Reformed and back at Richmond; punched his abusive father and told Keeley he loves her.

characters.name: Rupert Mannion
characters.line: Now owns West Ham United and has installed Nate as his weapon against Rebecca.

characters.name: Roy Kent
characters.line: Retired player turned Sky pundit turned coach on Ted's staff, still with Keeley but shaken by Jamie's confession.

characters.name: Keeley Jones
characters.line: Launching her own PR firm, with Roy, and privately unsettled by both Jamie's declaration and Nate's kiss.

characters.name: Sharon Fieldstone
characters.line: The sports psychologist Ted came to trust, who has now moved on from the club.

beats.label: S3 · Nate on the other side
beats.text: Richmond return to the Premier League projected for last, while former assistant Nate begins the season as West Ham's celebrated manager and publicly mocks Ted.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's central inversion: the man Ted mentored is now his enemy and outclassing him publicly.

beats.label: S3 · Zava, then no Zava
beats.text: To spite Rupert, Rebecca poaches eccentric superstar Zava for Richmond; the team enjoy a winning streak before Zava abruptly retires.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Richmond spend the middle of the season having to find belief without a saviour — the setup for Total Football.

beats.label: S3 · Roy and Keeley apart
beats.text: Roy and Keeley break up as her new PR firm consumes her time; she begins a relationship with wealthy investor Jack that ends when a private video of Keeley leaks online.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The relationship the reader has tracked since season 1 has quietly dissolved; needed to make their reunion at season's end land.

beats.label: S3 · West Ham crush Richmond
beats.text: West Ham humiliate Richmond in the sides' first meeting; Nate privately regrets his defection but Rupert convinces him to bury it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The low point that forces Richmond to reinvent themselves, and the first crack in Nate's certainty about Rupert.

beats.label: S3 · Amsterdam turns the season
beats.text: In Amsterdam Ted stumbles onto a Total Football strategy that revives Richmond's season, while Rebecca is rescued from a canal by a kind Dutch pilot she cannot forget.
beats.whyLoadBearing: One trip supplies both the tactical reset that runs the rest of the season and the man Rebecca meets again in the finale.

beats.label: S3 · Colin comes out, Nate walks out
beats.text: Colin comes out as gay to a supportive locker room, while Nate quits Rupert's West Ham after seeing his true character and quietly rejoins Richmond as an assistant kit man.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The team's culture and Nate's redemption both land here; without this, his presence at the end of the season is unearned.

beats.label: S3 · Ted goes home, Roy takes over
beats.text: Richmond finish second by beating Rupert's West Ham as Rupert's misconduct ends his ownership; Ted returns to Kansas, Roy becomes head coach, and Rebecca sells nearly half the club to its fans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The state every major character lands in as the series closes; the emotional payoff of the entire run.

cliffhanger.text: Ted has returned to Kansas to coach his son's soccer team, leaving Richmond in the hands of new head coach Roy Kent. Nate is back at the club, Rebecca has sold 49 percent of it to the fans, and has just recognised the Dutch pilot who once rescued her from a canal as the father of a child at the airport.
questions: Can Roy run Richmond the way Ted did, without Ted?
Will Rebecca and the Dutch pilot become something now that they have met again?
Does Keeley's proposed AFC Richmond Women's Team ever come to be?

characters.name: Ted Lasso
characters.line: Manager who chose to leave Richmond and return home to be with his son in Kansas.

characters.name: Rebecca Welton
characters.line: Owner who publicly defeated Rupert, sold nearly half the club to the fans, and just met the mystery Dutchman again by chance at the airport.

characters.name: Nate Shelley
characters.line: Quit West Ham after seeing Rupert's real character and quietly rejoined Richmond as an assistant kit man.

characters.name: Rupert Mannion
characters.line: Disgraced by an affair and public assault, losing West Ham as his wife divorces him.

characters.name: Roy Kent
characters.line: Newly promoted head coach of Richmond, back together with Keeley and now in therapy with Sharon.

characters.name: Keeley Jones
characters.line: Runs a PR firm now funded by Rebecca, back with Roy, and has pitched a plan for an AFC Richmond Women's Team.

characters.name: Jamie Tartt
characters.line: Reformed star who reconciled with his estranged father and helped carry Richmond to a second-place finish.

characters.name: Coach Beard
characters.line: Ted's assistant who chose to stay in England and marry his on-and-off girlfriend Jane.

characters.name: Sam Obisanya
characters.line: Star player with his own Nigerian restaurant, snubbed from the national team by a vengeful Akufo.

characters.name: Colin Hughes
characters.line: Long-time Richmond winger who came out to his teammates and was embraced by the locker room.
